body: 2026-09-26 (before v0.3.0). /api/oauth/profile gives plan, subscription status, billing type and subscription_created_at only; the billing endpoint (subscription_details) answers oauth_token_not_accepted on api.anthropic.com and claude.ai is Cloudflare-gated. An estimate from the start day was wrong for a real account (anchor moved), so renewal was removed rather than guessed. Revisit only if an OAuth-accessible billing endpoint appears. Code: internal/cli/plan.go, provider/claude/subscription.go.
title: agx plan shows no renewal date
